stock.description: Zuoli Kechuang Micro-finance Company Limited functions as a micro-lender throughout the People's Republic of China. The company provides a comprehensive suite of credit products, encompassing unsecured, guaranteed, collateralized, and pledged loans. Its offerings cater to diverse enterprise clients, including those in agriculture and technology, as well as small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and microenterprises. Additionally, it extends financing for individual businesses, start-up ventures, and offers online micro-loans. Established in 2011, the firm was originally named Deqing Zuoli Kechuang Micro-finance Company Limited, officially adopting its current name in April 2014. Its corporate headquarters are located in Huzhou, China.
